scope: Registry metadata and tarball-integrity verification, package-lock-only dependency resolution, npm production-dependency audit, and limited static inspection. No package code, install scripts, wallet integration or financial operation was executed.

audit.scopeLimit: These are candidate dependency-graph findings, not verified vulnerabilities in the deployed GFOF site or proof that every affected server/runtime feature ships in a browser widget. Full applicability and remediation remain unreviewed.

staticFindings: The NPM artifact declares next@13.5.6 and broad wallet-adapter dependencies.
The inspected artifact contains remote-script/style loading and defaults autoConnect to true when unspecified. A pinned wrapper alone is insufficient to approve its entire dynamic asset chain.
It references Ultra endpoints and several external data/image/font origins. Our V2 quote preview and its strict CSP are not a reviewed execution integration for that artifact.
decision: Keep the candidate out of runtime dependencies, the public static bundle and page scripts. Do not broaden the current CSP, enable wallet connection or signing, or treat an integrity match as a security approval.
next: Resolve a maintained candidate/version and exact source/build/dependency provenance.
Review advisory applicability and remediation with a reproducible release lock.
Review every dynamic asset and network origin; disable auto-connect explicitly.
Complete fixed-mint, fee/protection, transaction and desktop/mobile acceptance before proposing activation.
